description: This file contains a report script for supplier-wise sales analytics in an ERP system, including functions to fetch and process stock ledger entries, supplier details, and generate report columns and data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the supplier-wise sales analytics report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on date filters.

methods.name: get_consumed_details
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries where items are consumed (negative actual_qty).

methods.name: get_suppliers_details
methods.description: Retrieves supplier information for items from purchase receipts and invoices, filtered by supplier if provided.

methods.name: get_material_transfer_vouchers
methods.description: Returns list of material transfer stock entries.
